request.query: For positive B and c at least one, (2 floor(B^c)+1)^(n*D) < (B+1)^N when c*n*D <= N/2

items.name: Nat.pow_lt_of_lt_clog
items.type: ∀ {b x y : ℕ}, y < Nat.clog b x → b ^ y < x

items.name: Nat.pow_lt_iff_lt_clog
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ {x y : ℕ}, b ^ y < x ↔ y < Nat.clog b x

items.name: FloorSemiring.eventually_mul_pow_lt_factorial_sub
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Ring K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [FloorSemiring K] (a c : K) (d : ℕ),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, a * c ^ n < ↑(n - d).factorial

items.name: Int.self_le_zpow_clog
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [inst_3 : FloorSemiring R]
  {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ (r : R), r ≤ ↑b ^ Int.clog b r

items.name: Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ {x : ℕ}, 1 < x → b ^ (Nat.clog b x).pred < x
